release_notes:
v2.0.26 — Auto Catalog Update + Manual Order Verification

Auto Catalog Update + Manual Order Verification

Two new opt-in features:

1) Auto Catalog Update (per supplier API)
- Automatically discovers NEW supplier services and stages them as editable drafts for review BEFORE they go live — nothing is published to your catalog without passing your review window.
- New review page (New IMEI / New Server Services) to edit, group-map, re-price, or delete drafts in the normal service editor; per-row + bulk delete supported, with pagination and grouping by mapped category.
- Configurable review window and default margin (percentage or flat) per API, overridable per individual service.
- Group-mapped drafts auto-publish to your live catalog once the review window passes; the supplier connection is recorded in API History exactly like a manual connect.
- Admin email notifications on both discovery and publish.
- Deleted drafts are tombstoned so they are never re-discovered; drafts are auto-pruned when a service is manually linked elsewhere or dropped by the supplier.

2) Manual Order Verification
- Optional per-service toggle "Manually verify before sending to API".
- Matching orders are held with a "Verification Needed" badge on the orders page; use "Verify Selected" to release them for normal processing.

Improvements:
- Themed, centered CAPTCHA panel on the customer and admin login screens.
- Auto-catalog review UI: page/size retained across edit, save, and delete.
- Safer supplier price-sync: non-fatal custom-field column changes so a single service can't abort the run.

Both features are OFF by default — enable Auto Catalog Update per API in Manage API, and Manual Verification per service.
